parameters.description: List the owner's macOS Reminders due within the next 7 days (overdue included). Takes no input.
Create a reminder in the owner's macOS Reminders. due_date is 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' (24h, local time), or '-' for none.
Create a macOS Calendar event in the first writable calendar. Times are 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' (24h, local); end after start.
List macOS Calendar events on one day. day is 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
Append a paragraph to a macOS Notes note, creating it if missing. note_body is plain text ('-' for none).
List issues in GRITui/nevnew. state is open/closed/all, limit max 30.
View one issue in GRITui/nevnew by number.
Create an issue in GRITui/nevnew. issue_body is required ('-' for empty).
Add a comment to an issue in GRITui/nevnew.
List pull requests in GRITui/nevnew. state is open/closed/merged, limit max 20.
View one pull request in GRITui/nevnew by number.
Get the diff of one pull request in GRITui/nevnew.

versionMetadata.name: Version 1
versionMetadata.description: Real tools for NevNew: macOS Reminders/Calendar/Notes via osascript, plus read/triage GitHub tools via gh. Called by NevNew through mcpo.
